column1: # The DLSS model setting (bbport.ini dlss_model), the one place its choices are written down.
# scripts/gen_settings_tables.py turns it into gpu/shim/bbport_dlss_models.h (the game's
# settings and in-game menu) and launcher/bbport_dlss_models.py (the launcher); a test fails
# when either is out of date: run `python bloodborne_pc/scripts/gen_settings_tables.py`.
# Rows are in menu order. index is the value saved in settings and must never change for a model;
# a new model takes the next free index. preset is NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset (0: the
# driver's default, or Auto's per-frame pick, bbport_nvidia_gpu.h BbDlssAutoPreset). The presets
# are the ones DLSS 310 recommends; the deprecated and "do not use" ones are left out.
# Labels read "<name>: <summary>" in the launcher and "<name> - <summary>" in the game.

column2: The AI model DLSS uses. Auto follows NVIDIA per quality mode: on RTX 40 and 50, K for DLAA, Quality and Balanced, M for Performance, L for Ultra Performance; K in every mode on RTX 20 and 30. Default lets the driver choose.

column8: DLSS 4, for DLAA, Quality and Balanced
column9: DLSS 4, для DLAA, Quality и Balanced
